content: Customer Kiara Sen called insurance agent Neha Kapoor to discuss her health policy expiring on September 30, 2026, ahead of an upcoming surgery. Neha presented two options: renewing the current plan for $150/month or switching to a new plan for $130/month with pre-authorization services. Kiara chose the new $130/month plan, updated her contact and address details, provided her Visa credit card for payment, and successfully enrolled in the new policy starting October 1, 2026.
